title: Computation and Payment of Real Property Tax (Amilyar)
description: Have your real property tax computed and pay it at the City Treasurer's Office, and get a Realty Tax Clearance if you need one.
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Owners of real properties within Dipolog City

items: Notice of Assessment (NOA) from the City Assessor's Office
Previous official receipt of real property tax payment
Updated Tax Declaration or official receipt of updated realty tax payments
Official receipt for the certification fee

procedures.clientAction: Submit the requirements and wait for the computation of the tax due.
procedures.providerAction: Check the documents and the system to see whether tax payments are updated, then compute the tax due.
procedures.fee: Assessed Value × 3%, plus penalty if delinquent, less discount if paid in advance (as stated in the Charter)

procedures.providerAction: Advise the client of the tax due, accept payment and issue the official receipt (in the name of the person who actually paid).

procedures.clientAction: Optional: request a Realty Tax Clearance.
procedures.providerAction: Review the documents, prepare the clearance and forward it to the City Treasurer for signature, then release it.

contact.location: City Treasurer's Office, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall

notes: The Charter states that if taxes are up to date and advance payment is made within the period set by the city (it cites "until January 31 of the ensuing year"), the taxpayer gets a 20% discount on RPT dues. Confirm the current discount and deadlines with the City Treasurer's Office.
You can also pay real property tax online through the Dipolog City Online Services Portal (eservices.dipologcity.gov.ph).

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Copy of Tax Declaration
description: Request a copy of a property's tax declaration from the Dipolog City Assessor's Office.
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Owners of real properties within Dipolog City

items: Lot number, title or name of the owner

procedures.clientAction: Submit the requirements, sign the logbook and wait for the status of the request.
procedures.providerAction: Receive the request and check completeness (incomplete requests are returned), then print the tax declaration.

procedures.clientAction: Wait for approval and the Order of Payment.
procedures.providerAction: The Local Assessment Operations Officer countersigns and the City Assessor approves the tax declaration; the front desk prepares the Order of Payment.
procedures.personInCharge: Local Assessment Operations Officer / City Assessor / front desk

procedures.clientAction: Pay at the City Treasurer's Office, then submit the official receipt to Window 11, 12, 15 or 16.
procedures.providerAction: Release the tax declaration after the official receipt is presented and the logbook is signed.

contact.location: City Assessor's Office, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 15 minutes.
